goldRationale: Clause 4.1 permits withholding only for non-conformity plus failed cure after written notice; the record shows confirmed receipt, a cosmetic-only tweak request explicitly framed as 'no formal notice', an admission the non-payment 'is not about the work', and 45 days of silence. Clause 4.2 therefore makes the full contracted amount due.

meaningfulDivergence.description: What would count as a finding rather than a goalpost move
meaningfulDivergence.rule: A settled award below 8000 bps, or an escalation caused by a judge awarding below 5000 bps against one-sided claimant-favouring facts, is a meaningful divergence: report it as possible model variance (per the Phase 10/11 Nova-variance precedent) or a pipeline bug. Do NOT edit gold.json to match the panel.
